SW8,SW7 number of 5.25" drives 0,0 1 drive 0,1 2 drives 1,0 3 drives 1,1 4 drives SW6,SW5 type of display 0,0 reserved 0,1 40x25 color (mono mode) 1,0 80x25 color (mono mode) 1,1 mono 80x25 SW4,SW3 amount of memory on system board 64k chips 256k chips 0,0 64k 256k 0,1 128k 512k 1,0 192k 576k 1,1 256k 640k SW2 co-processor installed SW1 loop on POST

 64k chips 256k chips

0,1 128k 512k
1,0 192k 576k
1,1 256k 640k

SW2 co-processor installed
SW1 loop on POST
